applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eighth Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Apply a 100 per cent, 125 per cent, or 150 per cent risk weight to REIT exposures as specified in the new directions.
answer.action_quote: The Amendment Directions insert paragraph 61A in Chapter IV - ‘Risk Weighted Assets (RWAs)’ of the Directions, as under

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into force from October 1, 2026, or an earlier date

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025
